title: Dashboard: Replace first summary card with aggregated Monthly Target

requirements.summary: Replace the first top-row dashboard summary card label/content from “Total Goals” to “Monthly Target” while preserving the 5-card grid and all other summary cards.
acceptanceCriteria: When goals.length > 0, the top row still renders 5 cards in the same grid, but the first card’s label reads "Monthly Target" instead of "Total Goals".
No other summary cards (Total Target, Total Saved, Next Deadline, Emergency Fund) are removed or rearranged.

file_operations.description: Replace the first summary card markup/content to show a new "Monthly Target" card (keeping the existing 5-card grid structure and leaving the other 4 cards unchanged).

requirements.summary: Compute the dashboard "Monthly Target" as the sum of per-goal Monthly Target amounts using the same calculation rules as GoalCard, including deadline-based monthsRemaining and the <1 month correction; only include goals that would show a Monthly Target amount.
acceptanceCriteria: For a set of goals, the value shown in the new "Monthly Target" summary card equals the sum of the Monthly Target values that appear on those goals’ cards.
The summary uses the same global currency symbol logic as the other dashboard totals (EUR -> €; USD -> $).
The summed value is formatted to 2 decimal places (to match goal-card monthly target formatting).

file_operations.description: Add a shared utility to compute a goal’s Monthly Target amount using GoalCard’s exact rules (deadline-based monthsRemaining logic and the <1 month remaining correction) and to indicate when the Monthly Target amount should be considered “shown” for aggregation.
Refactor to use the shared monthly-target utility for the per-goal Monthly Target computation (keeping existing behavior/output identical) so the dashboard aggregation can match GoalCard exactly.

Use the shared monthly-target utility to sum only the goals that would display a Monthly Target amount in their GoalCard, and display the aggregated value with the existing global currency symbol logic and 2-decimal formatting.

requirements.summary: Match the new "Monthly Target" summary card styling/alignment to existing dashboard card template, using a left Calendar/Repeat icon in a 10x10 rounded wrapper and the GoalCard Monthly Target blue via `text-monthly-target`.
acceptanceCriteria: The new card’s internal structure matches the other summary cards’ structure: icon wrapper on the left + a text block with a small label and a large amount beneath it.
The icon uses the same left placement, size, and wrapper styling pattern as the other summary cards (w-10 h-10 rounded-lg + existing icon background utility class).
The amount text and the icon inherit the same blue as GoalCard’s Monthly Target value (via the `text-monthly-target` class) in both light and dark themes.
Visually, the large amount’s baseline aligns with the large amounts in the neighboring summary cards (no extra padding/margin causing the number to sit higher/lower).

file_operations.description: Update the new "Monthly Target" summary card to use the same internal layout classes as the other summary cards (left icon wrapper + label + amount), apply `text-monthly-target` to the icon and amount, and ensure spacing/typography matches neighboring cards for baseline alignment.
